description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'html_radios' that generates a list of HTML radio input elements with customizable options, values, labels, and attributes for use within Smarty templates.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios
methods.description: Generates HTML radio button inputs based on provided parameters, supporting options like values, labels, separators, and assignment to Smarty variables.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios_output
methods.description: Produces the HTML markup for a single radio input and its label, considering selection state and optional labels.
